summary.en: Kogoro takes Conan out to look for a Korean restaurant in the city and witnesses a hit and run resulting in two pedestrians being injured. A witness reveals he saw the car waiting for those two before speeding into their direction and Conan concludes it was an attempted murder.

victims.name: Shinzaburo Tatematsu and Kiyotaka Okonogi
victims.nameZh: 立松新三郎与小此木清隆
